only_user_favorite.description: If `true`, only Timelines that the current user has marked as favorite are returned.

timeline_type.description: Restrict results to `default` investigation timelines or `template` timeline templates.

sort_field.description: Field used to sort the list (`title`, `description`, `updated`, or `created`).

sort_order.description: Whether to sort the results `ascending` or `descending`

page_size.description: How many results should returned at once

page_index.description: How many pages should be skipped

search.description: Allows to search for timelines by their title

status.description: Filter by timeline lifecycle state (`active`, `draft`, or `immutable`).
